children: Overview
US SaaS healthcare platform's Q3 revenue rose and beat analyst expectations
Company posted Q3 net loss of $11.0 mln
Company raised 2026 revenue and adjusted EBITDA outlook
Outlook
Amwell raises 2026 revenue outlook to $204 mln-$206 mln from $200 mln-$205 mln
Amwell raises 2026 adjusted EBITDA outlook to ($8) mln-($7) mln from ($9) mln-($7) mln
Company expects 2026 AMG visits between 1.32 mln and 1.37 mln
Result Drivers
SUBSCRIPTION AND VISIT REVENUE - Co said Q3 revenue was driven by subscription revenue of $23.9 mln and Amwell Medical Group visit revenue of $23.7 mln
MEMBER ENGAGEMENT - Co said activating more members and simplifying their experience contributed to Q3 results
